en.name: Seabreeze
en.brief: A houseboat holiday rental needed a site that turns visitors into booking enquiries, for guests arriving from across Europe.
did: First version built on Wix, handed over with a 29-page guide in February 2026.
Rebuilt in October 2026 as a fast hand-coded site connected to bookings.
Copy, structure, design, build and hosting setup.
en.result: The owner compared both versions and chose the new one. It is moving to his own domain and his own Netlify account.

en.name: EQM Sellier
en.ownerNote: Workshop of master saddler Ivan Persico
en.brief: A workshop making bespoke saddles, bridles and competition trunks by hand needed to move from an old WordPress site to a real shop, without losing the consultation-first way it sells a saddle that costs several thousand euros.
did: A complete custom Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme, in Italian and English.
A bespoke saddle page with a visual timeline, leather swatches and a quote form tracked as a funnel.
A repair request form for the workshop.
Cart drawer, predictive search, filters and a sticky buy button on mobile.
Product pages ready for 3D and augmented reality using Shopify's native model viewer.
Structured data for products, organisation, breadcrumbs, articles and FAQ.
A WordPress to Shopify redirect map, a keyword map and a Journal plan.
Email recovery flows, analytics setup and a plain-language handover document.
details: The consultation-first flow for high-ticket bespoke products: the aim is a conversation, not a checkout.
Augmented reality loads only on products that have a model, so the rest of the shop stays fast.
A palette and type system built into theme settings, so the client can change the look without touching code.
en.result: Ready to launch, waiting on the client's photography and final prices.

en.name: Graziano Tumbarello
en.brief: A professional saxophonist booked for weddings and events needed a site that answers a couple's questions and gets them to message him.
did: Single-page site in Italian: hero, services, repertoire, reviews, FAQ, gallery.
A WhatsApp booking button, because that is how his clients actually write.
Local search setup for weddings and events in western Sicily.

en.name: Emergency home services company
en.brief: A home services company offering 24-hour emergency call-outs needed to be found by people searching in a panic, and needed a way to track the leads that came in.
did: Four-page website with all Italian copy: home, services, about, contact.
Google Business Profile set up and filled in.
A lead tracker so enquiries stop getting lost.
A plan for Meta and Google Maps advertising.
en.result: Delivered. The client's name, logo, domain and phone number are not shown here.

en.name: La Dolce Vita Luxury Experience
en.brief: A luxury concierge service needed a brand and a website that would speak to travellers who expect access rather than packages.
did: Brand identity, logo, Webflow website, copy and digital presence. 2025 to 2026.

en.name: victoriaswart.com
en.brief: My own site, rebuilt to show what I actually do instead of describing it.
did: Four languages with full hreflang and a switcher that keeps you on the same page.
Self-hosted fonts, no cookies, no analytics, no third-party requests.
Structured data for a person and her services.
Every case study written from a real project.
en.result: Live, and the starting point for every client site I build.
